name: Langsuir
description: The Langsuir is a female revenant of Malay folklore, the ghost of a woman who died in or shortly after childbirth, who flies as a beautiful long-haired woman or as a floating head trailing entrails and feeds on the blood of newborns through a hole in the back of her neck.
origin: Belief in the Langsuir is found throughout the Malay world: peninsular Malaysia, Indonesia, Singapore, Brunei, parts of southern Thailand and the southern Philippines.
